items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The fix is two lines: `if auth: netloc = auth + '@' + (netloc or '')`. It is clear and matches the surrounding style. It has no comment saying why auth is re-attached (the reference has one), but the rubric treats that as a minor gap.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: A minimal local change inside prepend_scheme_if_needed. It uses the auth value parse_url already returns, adds no new helpers, and leaves no dead code or debug output.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: `(netloc or '')` guards against a None netloc, and the change only runs when auth is truthy. It has no magic constants and swallows no exceptions. All tests pass, including the hidden ones (F2P 2/2, P2P 185/185).

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged, and auth from parse_url is joined back onto netloc only when present, so URLs without credentials behave as before. There is no Python-version check and no urllib3 pinning, and the credentials are not re-encoded.
